tekst o nama 1: The practice is headed by Dr. Jelena Ćosović-Šekularac, a veterinary specialist with particular expertise in abdominal surgery and orthopedics for dogs and cats, as well as in the treatment and surgery of exotic animals.
tekst o nama 2: Throughout her long career, she has been dedicated to precise diagnostics, the application of modern therapeutic methods, and an individualized approach to every patient, with the aim of providing the highest quality healthcare and achieving the best possible treatment and recovery outcomes.
tekst o nama 3: She is a member of the Small Animal Veterinary Association (SASAP) and the Veterinary Chamber of Serbia. She holds a license for independent practice from the Veterinary Chamber of Serbia.
tekst o nama 4: Dr. Jelena actively pursues continuous professional development by participating in domestic and international congresses, professional gatherings, and specialized courses.
tekst o nama 5: In this way, she keeps up with the latest advancements in veterinary medicine and continuously enhances her knowledge and skills, with a particular focus on abdominal surgery, orthopedics, and exotic animal medicine.
tekst o nama 6: In addition, her areas of interest include cardiology, anesthesiology, emergency veterinary medicine, ultrasound diagnostics, and internal veterinary medicine.
tekst o nama 7: Dr. Ivana Nikić is a doctor of veterinary medicine with a special interest in the medicine and treatment of exotic animals.
tekst o nama 8: She gained and honed her professional experience while working at veterinary clinics in the United Arab Emirates, where she had the opportunity to enhance her knowledge and practical skills in treating various types of exotic pets. She holds an ISVPS certification in exotic animal medicine, which attests to her commitment to professional development and expertise in this specialized field of veterinary medicine.
tekst o nama 9: In her work, she is dedicated to an individual approach to each patient, careful diagnosis and providing adequate veterinary care, with a special understanding of the specific needs and health challenges of exotic animals.
tekst o nama 10: Veterinary technician Ivana Baša is at the beginning of her professional career; she is characterized by gentleness, patience, and dedication to animals, as well as a sincere desire to learn and improve her knowledge and skills every day.
tekst o nama 11: In her work, she participates in the care and treatment of patients, as well as in maintaining hygiene and bathing the animals, while ensuring their comfort, safety, and well-being.
tekst o nama 12: With a conscientious approach and a readiness for professional development, she contributes to a pleasant environment and high-quality care for every pet.
tekst o nama 13: Sanja Nedović is a final-year student at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine, dedicated to acquiring practical knowledge and developing the skills necessary for work in modern veterinary practice.
tekst o nama 14: Through daily work with animals, she gains valuable experience in their care, diagnosis, and treatment, supported by more experienced colleagues. She is characterized by responsibility, empathy, and a willingness to learn, as well as a strong interest in further developing her professional expertise.
tekst o nama 15: Her goal is to successfully combine the theoretical knowledge she has acquired with practical experience and to build a foundation for a future professional career in veterinary medicine.
tekst o nama 16: Kristina Milićević is a professional dog groomer. She specializes in the grooming and styling of breeds such as the Bichon, Poodle, and Pomeranian, where precision, knowledge of breed standards, and an eye for aesthetics are of particular importance.
tekst o nama 17: In her work, she combine expertise, patience, and a love for animals, tailoring the treatment to each dog's temperament, needs, and coat type. She pay special attention to hygiene, details, and the pet's comfort throughout the entire grooming process.
tekst o nama 18: Her goal is that every dog, in addition to a neat and well-groomed appearance, has a pleasant and safe experience during grooming.

naslovna-tekst: The practice for pets and exotic animals provides services of the highest standard in diagnostics, treatment and surgical interventions. We specialize in abdominal surgery and orthopedics in pets and exotic animals.
naslovna-tekst-1: Each patient receives an individual approach. We try to make going to the vet stress-free for your furry, feathered and armored family members.
